questions.question: Is the source-status signal the coprocessor reads a digital DC-input-present signal, or the DC input's voltage read as an analogue signal, and does it also serve the DC input brownout detection, or does brownout detection need a second, separate signal?
questions.why: P2 cannot choose between a comparator/logic part (digital) and an ADC-input circuit (analogue) for the source-status signal, or size the GPIO/ADC pin budget for it, without knowing its form and whether it is shared with DC input brownout detection
questions.for_quantity: source-status signal form (digital DC-input-present or analogue DC input voltage) and whether shared with DC input brownout detection

questions.question: At which DC input voltage, in V, must the DC input brownout detection trip (falling), and at which voltage does it reset (rising): the source selection's existing 10.1 V falling / 11.0 V rising gate, or different values?
questions.why: P2 cannot qualify a part or circuit for the DC input brownout detection without a trip and reset threshold
questions.for_quantity: DC input brownout detection trip voltage (V, falling) and reset voltage (V, rising)

questions.question: How long, in ms, must the DC input stay below the brownout threshold before the DC input brownout detection counts it as a brownout (the qualifying or debounce time)?
questions.why: P2 cannot qualify a part or circuit for the DC input brownout detection's timing without a qualifying time, and the coprocessor cannot distinguish a real brownout from a brief transient without it
questions.for_quantity: DC input brownout detection qualifying time (ms)
